message.content: In the discussions regarding the game "Black Myth: Wukong," LiHua mentions an exciting moment from his gameplay experience. Specifically, he recalls having an "amazing battle scene" where he had to outsmart a giant enemy. The satisfaction he felt from successfully strategizing and the impressive visual display made this battle scene particularly memorable and rewarding. This showcases how the game offers engaging and dynamic gameplay experiences that leave a lasting impression on players.
